workspace.intro: Personalise your home screen with your own logo, photo and brand colours; hide modules and arrange your My Favourites list. The personalisation centre opens on the home screen and shows changes live before you apply them. You can also change the view mode (Day, Night, Reading, Focus) from the top bar of the home screen.
workspace.demoNote: On the demo account personalisation can only be viewed; changes cannot be saved.
workspace.footer: Personalisation changes only your own home screen look; your module permissions, client records and inner module screens are not affected.
